paragraphs.text: Killbot is an acorn artifact creature type used for cards that depict robots designed especially for killing. They are currently exclusively used for the Unstable League of Dastardly Doom . They were invented by Mary O'Kill .
Unstable features four Killbot creature cards that exist at the same collector number . This means that you can have 16 Killbots in a deck.
Mary O'Kill can switch a Killbot or Mary O'Kill in your hand with one on the battlefield .
